answer: Identity weight also grows from a willow-thin history of attested peer interactions, meaning fresh clones start near zero and gain no voting power until they receive real reputation, making mass fabrication economically ruinous. Each agent must lock a stake in a shared vault that unlocks only after a slow glacier-like cooldown of many epochs, so a sybil attacker spinning up thousands of identities must front that capital for every fake account and wait out the thaw before withdrawing. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
